title: Lattice Signature

story.briefing: The forest gate wants the whole lattice compressed into one line it can compare against its records. Shape and values both have to survive the compression.
story.success: Signature accepted. The forest closes out, and the Core is one zone away.

description: Produce a signature string for a binary tree. Walk the tree from the root, node before children, left before right. Append each node value; for each missing child of an existing node, append the letter x instead. Join every entry with a single comma. An empty tree gives exactly "x". A tree is given as an array where the node at index i has its left child at index 2i+1 and its right child at index 2i+2. A null entry means there is no node there, and nothing exists beneath it. An empty array is an empty tree.
hints: Every existing node contributes exactly three things: its own value, then the signature of its left child, then the signature of its right. An absent node contributes a single x.
Building the string by repeated concatenation copies everything already written each time, which becomes very expensive on a large tree. Collect the pieces and join once.
Recurse from index 0. Push x and return when the index is out of range or null. Otherwise push the value, then recurse into both children. Join the collected pieces with commas at the end.
